messages:
maya: Heads-up team: soft-freeze for this week's release train starts in 90 minutes. Only critical fixes or planned rollout items allowed after freeze. Please flag anything urgent now. :lock:

indra: Noted. Which streams are in-scope for the soft-freeze?

maya: In-scope: runtime kernel changes, routing policies, and config flags for batching. Out-of-scope: docs, perf dashboards, experiment toggles not tied to rollout.

noah: We're planning a regional dark-launch for dynamic-batching in us-west to validate throughput with real traffic. Canary will be 5% traffic for 2 hours then evaluate.

tina: Any DB or statefulness implications for dynamic-batching? Our session store team needs to know.

maya: No schema or session-store changes. It's a serving-layer change only. It changes how we group short requests at ingress.

leo: deploy-bot: `darklaunch-start` ts=1789123580 id=dl-21 region=us-west scope=5% duration=2h. Initial checks: queue-depth ok, tail-latency +6% (expected), error-rate 0.4%.

noah: Observed a small bump in p95 for short chats, digging into batching thresholds. Might need to lower max-batch-size for seq<64.

indra: If p95 stays >10% above baseline at the 30m mark, we should roll back automatically. Confirmed?

maya: Yes. Health gate at t+30m and t+90m. Gate failure -> auto-rollback. Rollback command: `./ops/release rollback --id dl-21` and post to #incidents.

leo: Also, Oxford region will be excluded from dark-launch due to capacity constraints. Documented in the rollout notes.

maya: Policy change note: for release trains going forward, any security-related exception must include a risk summary and oncall sign-off in the PR. Executives asked for this after last month's surprise hotfix.

noah: PR link for batching thresholds: https://git.internal/r/4890. I'll request oncall sign-off now.

deploy-bot: health-check summary: checks=[error-rate,tail-latency,cpu-saturation], thresholds=(err<1%, p95<=baseline*1.10, cpu<75%). Current: err=0.4%, p95=1.06x, cpu=62%.

maya: Thanks. @indra @leo please be available for first hour of dark-launch. I'll send a 1-line exec update at 30m if all green.
